rule: The execution record. The forecast is not edited; a wave that finds the design must change writes the change and the reason here.

design.policy: `HistoryRange { Full, Trailing(usize) }` in exec/kv.rs beside LayerKvGeometry, with `HistoryRange::of_span(span, window)` — ONE exhaustive match over AttentionSpan, the only place the policy is written — and `required_range(position) -> Range<usize>` (= required_start(position)..position + 1).
design.mapping: Sliding + Some(w) → Trailing(w); Sliding + None → Full (no declared bound to apply); Full → Full; Windowed → Full (its extent is spatial, not a position count — the AttentionSpan::Windowed doc already forbids inferring dead positions from it). Exactly the two formulas it replaces.
design.plan_owned: `AttentionOp::history()` = of_span(op.span, op.window). LayerKvGeometry gains `history: HistoryRange`, set from the plan op in plan_continuation_geometry (ConvQkv and any other KV side: Full), so the authority reaches providers (B needs it in V4). `window` stays a geometry fact, informational as before.
design.backends: reference, production and device take their floor from `call.history().required_range(position).start`, where `AttentionCall::history()` = of_span(call.span, call.window) — the call's span and window are copied from the plan op at the one construction site (exec/mod.rs). production's `source_start` becomes a thin call to it (device reuses it); reference's local match is deleted.
design.why_a_field_on_geometry: `LayerKvGeometry.window` is copied from op.window regardless of span (exec/continuation.rs:260). A provider that read `window` alone would drop rows on a Full or Windowed layer carrying Some(w). The span-aware authority must travel with the geometry.
design.not_changed: larql-compute's `window_start` (V2 GQA) and the Metal lowering's window: different paths, outside VIEW-1's backends

witnesses_planned.behaviour_neutral_table: required_range(position).start equals the replaced formula for every span × window ∈ {None, 1, 3, 1024} × position ∈ 0..2100
witnesses_planned.S2_scan: a source scan: no reference/production/device backend file matches on AttentionSpan or computes a floor from `window`; seeded-violation RED control
witnesses_planned.parity: the full larql-vindex / larql-kv / larql-inference suites unchanged, and the MEM-1 harness's row/canonical bit-identical parity on the fixtures
